claim: Nevada's commercial renewable projects have relied on complex financing structures and government incentives to achieve economic viability, as demonstrated by the Nellis Solar Power Plant, where a power purchase agreement at about 2.2 cents/kW·h—compared to the 9 cents Nellis was paying to Nevada Power—combined with multimillion-dollar government incentives enabled the partners to recover costs and produce electricity at a savings.
label: unsupported
